summary: FOXO Technologies filed an 8-K reporting exchange agreements with two institutional holders of Series A Preferred Stock. The company exchanged an aggregate of 7,775.08528 preferred shares with $7.775M stated value for two senior unsecured non-convertible promissory notes totaling $7.775M. The preferred shares were cancelled, eliminating future equity conversion rights. The notes are non-interest bearing, mature May 12, 2027 (or upon default), and are subordinated only to senior indebtedness. Repayment is tied to a public offering or up-listing. This debt-for-equity swap simplifies the capital structure and removes potential overhang from convertible instruments. Watch for the company's ability to up-list or repay at maturity.
